description: This Java source file defines the NotificationInd class, which represents the MIME-based M-Notification.ind protocol data unit (PDU) used in multimedia messaging services (MMS). It provides methods to construct, parse, and manipulate various headers related to MMS notifications, such as content class, content location, expiry, sender information, message class, and transaction ID.

classes.name: NotificationInd
classes.description: Represents an MMS notification indication PDU, providing accessors and mutators for its various headers, enabling construction and parsing of notification messages in the MMS protocol.
